newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said on Wednesday.

"The interbank rate eased slightly today but had little impact on the market. Treasury bills yields were slightly lower but bond prices were slightly higher. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.16/1.11 percent compared with Tuesday's yield of 1.23/1.18 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.62/1.57 percent against 1.70/1.65 percent.
